profile.name: Manas Patil
profile.about: Highly skilled in training machine learning models, developing Voice AI engines, and constructing RAG pipelines. Expertise in deploying real-world AI solutions seamlessly integrated with scalable full-stack web architectures using React.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.

highlights: Architected a real-time AI Calling System utilizing LiveKit and LLMs to enable low latency voice interactions.
Built a RAG-powered WhatsApp E-commerce chatbot by integrating vector databases and generative AI.
Managed the end-to-end ML pipeline, handling data preprocessing, feature engineering, and deploying ML models.
Developed and deployed a responsive web application using React.js, Node.js, and HTML/CSS.
Programmed backend integrations for real-time form submissions and automated call scheduling.

work.title: Sub-Millisecond Voice Activity Detection (VAD) with Custom Wakeword
work.description: A lightweight, edge-optimized Voice Activity Detection and custom wakeword recognition engine built from scratch in PyTorch. Features a Broadcasted Residual Network (BC-ResNet) capable of sub-millisecond inference and utilizes custom Focal Loss to handle massive dataset imbalances.

work.title: Artificial Neural Networks from Scratch
work.description: Engineered a complete Artificial Neural Network from scratch using pure mathematics and NumPy. Implemented core components including Dense Layers, Backpropagation, Binary Cross Entropy Loss, Softmax activation, and the ADAM optimizer without relying on high-level deep learning frameworks.

work.title: Real-Time AI Calling System
work.description: Architected a low-latency AI calling system enabling seamless voice interactions. Developed during my AI Internship at SiyaraTech Innovations. (Note: As this is a proprietary company project, the source code is not publicly available).

work.title: Full-Stack RAG Chatbot Engine
work.description: Architected an asynchronous, multi-modal ingestion pipeline that processes complex PDFs and generates accurate AI responses backed by precise, verifiable document citations.

work.title: RAG-Powered WhatsApp E-Commerce Bot
work.description: Built a generative AI chatbot for WhatsApp to automate customer queries and facilitate e-commerce flows. Developed during my AI Internship at SiyaraTech Innovations. (Note: As this is a proprietary company project, the source code is not publicly available).

work.title: Hibiscus CNN Classifier
work.description: A deep learning-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model for classifying Hibiscus leaf species (Rosa-Senis, Canabinus, Mutabilis) using image data. Trained on 5,100 samples using morphological features like petal length, color, and sepal length.

work.title: ANN for MNIST Dataset from Scratch
work.description: Built a custom Artificial Neural Network from the ground up using pure NumPy to classify the MNIST handwritten digit dataset, implementing mathematical foundations for forward passes, backpropagation, and optimization.

work.title: ClassMantra AI Educator Assistant
work.description: Developed a full-stack educational web application featuring automated assignment grading and AI-generated feedback mechanisms.

work.title: Zero: The Focus App
work.description: A productivity and focus application featuring a minimalist UI design heavily inspired by the Nothing OS dot-matrix aesthetic.

work.title: Language Translator Android Application
work.description: A mobile application for translating text between multiple languages utilizing Firebase ML capabilities for seamless translation.

research.title: Data-Driven Rockfall Assessment using Synthetic Training and CNN–XGBoost Integration
research.description: Engineered a hybrid deep learning model using Synthetic Training and CNN-XGBoost integration to predict physical anomalies in open-pit mines. Structured complex datasets and optimized the neural network architecture.
